line.edit.banner: Editing the stops of the trip {trip}. Click stops to add them, move or remove them in the list, then save. Times, tours and the line stay.
line.status.trip_track: The trip {name} runs on a track of its own or does not exist; its stops cannot be edited here.
line.status.trip_missing: The trip {name} stops at the object {id}, which is not a stop object of the map.
timetable.manage.stops.tooltip: Open the line tool on the stops of this trip: add, move or remove stops, and the way between them is found again.
timetable.stoptimes.hint: Minutes after the trip began. A stop with a time is one the bus waits at; stops without one are timed from the running time and the lengths of the station links.
timetable.stoptimes.invalid: A time is minutes after the trip began, such as 2.5.
